title: Bigger Baskets.
text: Bigger Baskets.. The caddy fits into my bathroom perfectly, and the baskets are deeper and larger than the ordinary caddy baskets.  Now my husband wants one in his bathroom, too.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Bathroom Shower Storage Constant Tension Corner Pole Caddy - Adjustable Height, 4 Positionable Baskets - for Organizing and Containing Hand Soap, Body Wash, Wash Cloths, Razors - Bronze
features: STRONG & SECURE: This item features patented, Constant Tension Technology. This technology ensures constant tension throughout the length of the pole and keeps the rod secure at any height - This eliminates shifting over time; The plastic ends also keep the item from slipping or scratching surfaces; Open grid design allows for maximum drainage and air circulation, items dry quickly, reducing the risk of mold and mildew

4 BASKETS: Featuring 4 baskets / shelves, providing you with ample storage for all of your shower essentials; Store soap, lotions, oils, shaving cream and more; One basket features a built-in towel bar for hand towels and wash cloths, Another features two hooks for hanging razors, foot scrubbers, pumice stones, loofahs, poofs and more; The remaining two baskets offer additional storage space, and one is extra deep for larger items; Baskets can be positioned in any location along the pole

ADJUSTABLE & SAVES SPACE: The adjustable tension pole allows you to use this item with ceilings from 5 feet to 9.5 feet high; The patented constant tension technology assures you of strong, secure hold at any height; Stable design allows you to hold even your largest shampoo and conditioner bottles; The largest basket is also great for storing bath toys; The corner basket design allows you to maximize space in your shower and bathtubs, making the most of unused corners

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of solid steel with a durable rust-resistant finish and non-slip plastic end caps; All hardware, hex wrench, and instructions are included with the item; No other tools (drills or screwdrivers) are needed to assemble
GENEROUSLY SIZED: Measures 9.75" x 8.25" x 9.5' high, when fully extended; Extends from 5' to 9.5' high (1.5 - 2.9 meters)
description: The Bathroom Shower and Bathtub Tension Pole Caddy from mDesign takes storage vertical for space saving organization in the bathroom shower or bathtub. Four basket shelves can be arranged at different heights to accommodate tall shampoo and conditioner bottles as well as small bottles and bars of soap. The product also has a towel bar and hooks for organizing smaller items. Keep all of your bath essentials easily at hand and organized. The unique, organic wire design makes this a beautiful addition to any home. Maximize your space with this vertical storage caddy!
